images.note: Later depiction: 1840 miniature portrait after Marchant (NPG); beat: Andrew Jackson, hero of New Orleans. Post-war likeness (25 years after 1815); no second institution has a qualifying high-res portrait.

images.note: Later, fictive depiction: 'The Dying Tecumseh' marble sculpture (modeled 1864-65, stood in U.S. Capitol 1864-78); beat: Tecumseh and his death at the Thames. No authenticated contemporary portrait of Tecumseh exists; honest gap for a life likeness.
images.title: "The Dying Tecumseh" sculpture (fictive portrait)
